name: rankzero
description: Connect to RankZero for AI search visibility, competitors, prompts, citations, GA4, and Google Search Console insights.

interface.longDescription: RankZero measures how visible a brand is in AI search: how often AI assistants and AI search engines mention it when they answer the questions its customers ask, how it ranks against competitors, and which websites those answers cite. This plugin connects to your RankZero account so you can analyze that data in a conversation. Ask for a brand's visibility percentage and rank over the last 24 hours, 7, 30 or 90 days, see which competitors are mentioned alongside it, review recent AI answers to your tracked prompts, list the most-cited sources, and query the brand's connected Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console data. The plugin only reads data and only sees the brands your RankZero account owns or shares through its organization. A RankZero account is required.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my RankZero AI search visibility and tell me what changed and what I should investigate next.
